@graph.rdfs:label: Parametric Trigger Event (PTE)
@graph.rdfs:comment: A predefined forensic condition that, when verified by a PTCE, triggers deterministic smart contract responses.

@graph.rdfs:label: Structural Collapse / Critical Pathology
@graph.rdfs:comment: Triggers immediate ForensicFreeze and halts secondary transfers.

@graph.rdfs:label: PRRB Downgrade to Speculative
@graph.rdfs:comment: Triggers YieldRatingAdjusted and redirects distributions to maintenance escrow.

@graph.rdfs:label: Registry Divergence / Double Pledge
@graph.rdfs:comment: Triggers immediate freeze and Atomic Receiver invocation.

@graph.rdfs:label: Telemetry Loss > 72h
@graph.rdfs:comment: Triggers automatic PRRB downgrade and mandatory re-inspection.

@graph.rdfs:label: Operator Control Loss
@graph.rdfs:comment: Triggers Atomic Receiver step-in after 30 days.

@graph.rdfs:label: Circuit Breaker Status
@graph.rdfs:comment: Current operational state of the asset's secondary market transferability based on APRIS parametric triggers.

@graph.rdfs:label: Infrastructure Fee
@graph.rdfs:comment: The fee deducted atomically during Capex Escrow release (0.1% - 0.25% of released amount).

@graph.rdfs:label: Atomic Receiver Address
@graph.rdfs:comment: The Ethereum address of the bankruptcy-remote receiver invoked upon severe pathology.

@graph.rdfs:label: PIPC Policy Reference
@graph.rdfs:comment: Link to the Physical Integrity Parametric Cover policy that triggered the payout.

@graph.rdfs:label: Last Capex Release Timestamp
@graph.rdfs:comment: Unix timestamp of the last Capex Escrow release for the asset (enforces 72h cooldown).
